title: Better N' Better
description: A Modpack Optimizes and Enhance your Minecraft!
body:
Better N' Better---The Best Minecraft Optimization Modpack you will find!
In this Modpack, we have some game optimization mods and also configurations that boost your game's ram usage and FPS!

Also, we not just include optimization, but also game improvements such as more animations and better sound system! This both enhance your game experience and also optimize the performance!
